newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Treasure in HK$104 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: China Treasure in HK$104 mln rights issue.

text.p: China Treasure Telecom Holdings Ltd said on Monday it plans to raise HK$104 million through a one-for-one rights issue at HK$0.17 per share.
The subscription price represents a discount of about 39.3 percent to the closing price of HK$0.28 a share on October 24, before trading was suspended pending an announcement.
The cordless telephone manufacturer said it would apply for a resumption of share trading on Monday.
China Treasure would use the proceeds to repay bank borrowings and the principal of a convertible note issue and for working capital, it said in a statement.

The issue would be underwritten by Oriental Patron Asia Ltd, Kingsway S.W. Securities Ltd and Tai Fook Securities Co Ltd, the company said. Following the rights issue, the subscription price of its existing 1998 warrant is expected to be adjusted to HK$0.33 from HK$0.40.
The conversion price of its outstanding convertible note and convertible bond are expected to be adjusted to HK$0.57 and HK$0.26 from HK$0.70 and HK$0.32 per share, it said.
The company also proposes changing its name to CCT Telecom Holdings Ltd to reflect its new business strategy, particularly its focus on China's growing telecommunications industry.
